{"id":1993740681,"question_id":4295,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"2 months, 2 weeks","timestamp":1777775753,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"3 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1993740681/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Count Indices With Opposite Parity","memory":"32.8 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    vector<int> countOppositeParity(vector<int>& nums) {\n        vector<int>ans(nums.size());\n        int odd = 0 , even = 0;\n\n        for(auto it : nums) if(it & 1) odd++;\n        else even++;\n\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<nums.size() ; i++){\n            if(nums[i] & 1){\n                odd--;\n                ans[i] = even;\n            }\n            else {\n                even--;\n                ans[i] = odd;\n            }\n        }\n        return ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"count-indices-with-opposite-parity","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1965}
